name: brahmastra-academy
description: BrahmAstra Academy — the learning module of BrahmAstra Studio. React client (apps/web) and API server (apps/server).

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @academy/server & npm run dev --workspace @academy/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @academy/server && npm run build --workspace @academy/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @academy/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @academy/web
